technical_and_design_decisions: For U7 (module deployment migration), adopt a pluggable runtime SPI pattern to decouple deployment from the repository abstraction, leveraging Java ServiceLoader for discovery.
For U8 (isolated ModuleRunner), use Spring Boot's embedded container support to create a self-contained runner that does not require the full xd-containers runtime.
For U2 (CI build), integrate with the existing CI pipeline (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) by adding an 'install' target that runs Maven or Gradle install plugin.
For U4 and U5 (performance benchmarks), use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for reproducible and isolated benchmark tests.
For U6 (GPDB UX), simplify parameter escaping by introducing a dedicated parameter parser or wrapper that handles special characters transparently.
For U3 (XD+Kafka POC), structure the sample as a standalone Spring Boot application with embedded Kafka (or using testcontainers) for easy reproduction.

No external dependencies or third-party integrations require additional procurement or licensing.

activities.activity_description: Finish outstanding tasks for the DEBS challenge (likely a research or competition submission), including any unfixed bugs, missing features, or final integration steps required to meet the deadline.

activities.activity_name: Add CI build with install target
activities.activity_description: Modify the continuous integration configuration (e.g., Jenkinsfile or GitHub Actions YAML) to include an 'install' target (e.g., `mvn install` or `gradle install`) and verify that the pipeline runs successfully.

activities.activity_name: Publish XD + Kafka POC in samples repo
activities.activity_description: Create a proof-of-concept project demonstrating Spring XD integration with Apache Kafka, including source code, configuration, and a README. Commit to the designated samples repository and ensure it builds and runs.

activities.activity_name: Revisit performance benchmarks for jdbchdfs optimizations
activities.activity_description: Set up and run performance benchmarks focusing on the jdbchdfs module after recent optimizations. Analyze results, compare with previous baselines, and document findings. Adjust benchmarks as needed.

activities.activity_name: Bench test TupleBuilder for performance bottlenecks
activities.activity_description: Develop and execute microbenchmarks around the TupleBuilder class, identify performance hot spots, and apply targeted optimizations. Re-benchmark to confirm improvements.

activities.activity_name: Simplify GPDB parameter UX and test Sqoop jobs
activities.activity_description: Redesign the parameter handling for GPDB (Greenplum Database) to eliminate manual escaping of special characters. Implement the change and test end-to-end Sqoop jobs for both SQLServer and GPDB to validate UX improvement.

activities.activity_name: Migrate module deployment to pluggable runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Refactor the existing repository-based module deployment mechanism to use a pluggable Service Provider Interface (SPI). Define the SPI interfaces, implement the new deployment strategy, update existing consumers, and write unit/integration tests.

Develop a new Spring Boot application that acts as a lightweight ModuleRunner, capable of running in container environments without requiring the full xd-containers runtime. Package as an executable JAR, include necessary configuration, and verify isolation.
